evidence: Film growth was studied using in-situ quartz crystal microbalance, ex-situ X-ray reflectivity and ellipsometry. In-situ Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) was employed to understand the surface limited half-reactions. X-ray reﬂectivity measurements were executed with Bruker D8 Advanced diffractometer... X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy measurements in Thermo VG Scientiﬁc photoelectron spectrometer... Raman spectroscopy was performed in a Raman spectrometer... Cross-sectional SEM image and surface AFM image of the as-deposited ﬁlm... Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) measurements were carried out... Cyclic voltammetry was obtained with a scan rate of 0.2 mV s/C01
